'''House Mantear''' is one of the 19 Major [[:Category:Noble houses|Noble houses]] of [[Andor]]. [[File:Mantear.png|alt=Silver anvil on a background quartered red and blue|thumb|Sign of House Mantear]]

==Members==
*[[Perival Mantear]] - current [[High Seat]] of the house.
*[[Willin Mantear]] - elderly uncle of Perival.
* [[Galad Damodred|Galadidred Damodred]] - son of princess [[Tigraine Mantear]], adopted by Queen [[Morgase Trakand]].
*[[Mordrellen Mantear]] - former High Seat and former [[Queen of Andor]], mother of Tigraine and Luc.
*[[Tigraine Mantear]] - former [[Daughter-Heir]] of Andor and sister of Luc.
*[[Luc Mantear]] - former [[First Prince of the Sword]] of Andor and brother of Tigraine.
*[[Rand al'Thor]] - while he is the son of Tigraine, he has decided to keep his noble heritage a secret.
*[[Dolera Mantear]] - Former High Seat and Queen of Andor and mother of Mordrellen.

==History==
Mantear was the ruling House of Andor before Morgase won the '''[[Succession Wars|Third Succession War]]''' in NE 972. At this time, the [[Daughter-Heir]], Tigraine, was missing. This was due to the advice and [[Foretelling]]s of [[Gitara Moroso]], the advisor to Queen Mordrellen.

Mantear was the ruling house for several generations prior to House Trakand, but exactly how many is not known. Prior to Mantear, [[House Norwelyn]] was the ruling house.{{Ref/book|11|17}}

House Mantear had begun to run heavily into male children and, as such, there was no one for Mantear to put forward from their own House as a suitable candidate for the Lion Throne. After the death of Queen Mordrellen, a male-line branch of the family survived, but the closest female-only line relative was Lady [[Morgase Trakand]], a distant cousin who became the next queen of [[Andor]].

==Sigil==
The sigil of House Mantear is a silver anvil on a field quartered blue and red.{{ref/book|twotc}}

==Activities==
'''[[Succession Wars|Fourth Succession War]]''' - House Mantear (along [[House Taravin]], [[House Gilyard]], [[House Haevin]] and [[House Northan]]) was one of the first five Houses to lend its support to [[House Trakand]] in its bid for the [[Lion Throne]].{{ref/book|10|13}}
